tool.name: MRVBFTool
tool.summary: Multiresolution Valley Bottom Flatness (MRVBF) and Ridge Top Flatness (MRRTF) after Gallant & Dowling (2003), from a DEM, with slope and a 3-band composite.
tool.usage:
Needs a projected DEM with cell sizes in metres.

Writes the MRVBF grid to the output, and beside it <output>_MRRTF, <output>_slope and a 3-band <output>_RGB composite (R = MRRTF, G = MRVBF, B = slope).

param.name: in_raster
param.dialogReference: Digital elevation model in a projected coordinate system (metres).
param.pythonReference: Digital elevation model in a projected coordinate system (metres).

param.name: out_raster
param.dialogReference: Output MRVBF raster; the MRRTF, slope and RGB grids are written beside it.
param.pythonReference: Output MRVBF raster; the MRRTF, slope and RGB grids are written beside it.

param.name: t_slope
param.dialogReference: Initial threshold for slope (percent) at the finest resolution.
param.pythonReference: Initial threshold for slope (percent) at the finest resolution.

param.name: t_pctl_v
param.dialogReference: Threshold for the lowness percentile (valley bottom flatness).
param.pythonReference: Threshold for the lowness percentile (valley bottom flatness).

param.name: t_pctl_r
param.dialogReference: Threshold for the upness percentile (ridge top flatness).
param.pythonReference: Threshold for the upness percentile (ridge top flatness).

param.name: p_pctl
param.dialogReference: Shape parameter for the elevation percentile transformation.
param.pythonReference: Shape parameter for the elevation percentile transformation.

param.name: max_res
param.dialogReference: Coarsest resolution used, as a percentage of the grid diagonal.
param.pythonReference: Coarsest resolution used, as a percentage of the grid diagonal.
